article.title: Par aspectual читать/прочитать
article.chapter: Aspecto imperfectivo/perfectivo: fundamentos — Вид глагола: основы

claims.summary: Explains the difference between imperfective 'читать' and perfective 'прочитать' in Russian grammar.
Describes how 'читать' is used to indicate ongoing reading or habitual reading, while 'прочитать' is used to indicate a completed reading process.
Provides examples of sentences using 'читать' and 'прочитать' to illustrate their different meanings and usages.
